items.title: Tony Parenti and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-06-29
items.q: I don't don't pin I said a fellow that played with uh Don't be not Nick LaRocca He's down there Well, he was Nick down there was playing

ctx.x: Henry. I want to get that straight. There's so many out.

Well, Merritt and Henry. No, no. Well, Merritt was a trumpet player. There's only two trombone players. George and... George came, you know, later. But Henry was the... There was two trombones that Ernest Giordina used. And that was Eddie Edwards and Henry Brunas. They were two of the kings down there. It was... You might have heard about Tom Brown, but they could never play with Giordina's band, because Giordina would play stuff out unorthodox. You understand? He played more. Brown would only play what he knew,…

items.title: Emile Christian and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-02-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think it was Nick LaRocca told me about him.

ctx.x: Uh Tom? Yeah. I don't know. I don't know if Tom traveled.
I'm trying to remember. Somebody told me. I think it was Nick LaRocca told me about him. Maybe. Oh there's so many of them. Now uh what about Johnny Fisher? When did he get in Chicago?

I don't even know. He must have came after we left. Johnny was up there with me. He was playing with me up there. Did he come after we had gone? In 16. He was up there in 16? Yeah. You all uh you all left already for New York. You all left for New York.
